status: Source/predicate-interface direction only; not exact-card approval
changeClassification: KEEP all four operative feat procedures; NEW evidence-record contract and explicit bounded current-source dispositions
sharedAppend: External-credential evidence — FEAT327-ACQ-04. NEW evidence-contract completion; the four existing feat procedures and their prerequisite alternatives are retained. For frenzied_rage, divine_favor, elemental_body and dragon_blood, evaluate a required external credential under ACQ04-EC1 against the same character, world and ordered acquisition snapshot, using the exact operative prerequisite and source version, linked credential or event evidence, and that world's established authority for recording that fact. A source file establishes wording, not that a particular character acquired a feature, worships a deity, experienced an event or possesses a lineage. A name, nonempty story label, unchecked Boolean, prospective feat benefit or unrelated class/ancestry/item grant supplies no credential. The supporting grant, worship state or exposure event must already qualify before acquisition; same-time events require an authoritative earlier sequence. Worship must be established at that snapshot; exposure is a qualifying prior event, not a requirement to remain exposed. Apply the branch-specific facts and required choices in ACQ04-EC1 without adding doctrine, an exposure threshold, an element-to-plane matching rule or a legacy alias. A conditional, opaque test-world fixture can establish only a CONDITIONAL_ONLY predicate result within that fixture. It supplies no actual campaign history, selectable option, class feature, cosmology approval or entitlement. Missing, unbound, mismatched or insufficient evidence leaves a predicate UNESTABLISHED; affirmative incompatible evidence is CONTRADICTED. Neither result satisfies a required AND node, although a separately satisfied printed OR alternative remains valid. An ESTABLISHED_FOR_SNAPSHOT result requires independently admitted actual-world evidence and is not supplied by this review. Preserve all original source fields, absence/null distinctions, acquisition history and current status/selection flags. All other permanent-ability, level, parent-feat, mandatory-choice and earned-opportunity predicates remain independently required; one paid opportunity cannot fund two acquisitions. Later use still requires the exact feat's ongoing predicates. This evidence policy does not reopen ACQ-03 or change its casting-snapshot rules.

boundRef.meaning: Reference immutable complete bytes and the exact record/field. Resolve content and identity; verify the SHA256 binding. A hash proves byte identity, not truth or authority. JSON pointers may select a record containing the needed fields; exact text section anchors may be used for text sources. Existing versioned-record locators may be adapted losslessly to this binding without rewriting their originals. Never use a self-hash or cyclic fulfillment hash.

evidenceMode.meaning: All supporting records must remain in this evidence domain. A test fixture cannot be relabeled or mixed into a campaign acquisition.

worldId.meaning: Stable world identity matching acquisition, actor, evidence and authority. The referenced world and its record-authority configuration must resolve; a string alone is not proof.

characterId.meaning: Stable actor identity matching the acquisition snapshot and the subject of every supporting grant/state/event.

acquisitionRef.meaning: Resolve an immutable acquisition/snapshot record with this character/world, exact feat ID, authoritative elapsed-time-plus-sequence order, permanent abilities/class levels/parent ownership as applicable, mandatory choices and a source-qualified independently payable opportunity. Eligibility checking does not spend that opportunity or create a feat grant.

predicate.meaning: contractRef is a boundRef to the exact controlling prerequisite node/procedure; featId and branch select one of the four mappings below. Preserve the current AND/OR tree.

credentialRefs.meaning: Resolve actual supporting grants, state/event records, source clauses and their subject identity/establishment or occurrence order. Branch-specific facts below must be evidenced by their content, not merely by attachment presence. Existing records may be reused; duplicate storage is not required.

authorityRef.meaning: Resolve the existing world/character record authority and its actual scope to establish/admit the particular credential or event at the relevant time. No new witness, authentication service, religious adjudication or owner-confirmation gate is imposed. authorized:true is not a substitute for this binding.

choiceBindings.required: Only where the exact feat requires a choice or sourced type
choiceBindings.meaning: Elemental Body: exactly one actual permanent menu choice. Dragon Blood: exactly one value and bound source location establishing the ancestry/bloodline damage type for the same qualifying branch. No invented extra choice for Divine Favor or Frenzied Rage. Preserve meaningful absence/null rather than inserting fake values.

outcomes.CONDITIONAL_ONLY: Literal predicate satisfied under explicitly conditional mock premises; never a campaign acquisition or positive production credential.
outcomes.UNESTABLISHED: Required evidence missing, unbound, mismatched or insufficient; does not qualify, without asserting the event never happened.
outcomes.CONTRADICTED: Resolved evidence affirmatively fails this predicate, e.g. actual Mage supplied as Sorcerer.
outcomes.ESTABLISHED_FOR_SNAPSHOT: Only independently admitted campaign records can establish the external predicate for that snapshot. No such positive record is authenticated or supplied by this review; other acquisition gates remain separate.

chronology: Required state/grant/event must precede acquisition in the governing authoritative order. Equal elapsed timestamps require an earlier sequence. Worship must qualify at the snapshot; exposure remains a past-event predicate. Later assertions cannot fabricate an earlier grant/event. Legitimate source corrections preserve predecessors and their authority rather than silently rebasing history. No additional minimum worship/exposure duration is created.

frenzied_rage.wording: KEEP the complete Frenzied Rage procedure and CON15 AND (owned berserker OR actual acquired class rage ability). No operative card in the supplied17 class payloads expressly grants a qualifying class rage state. Mooncursed, Bear Form, Berserker Brew, Vengeful Smite's conduct clause, Zealot's Fervor, Blood Frenzy and Veinweave: Blood Frenzy do not establish that branch. Preserve the class alternative as an external source-qualified branch, not a permanently false rule and not an invented new class feature. The actual, separately paid berserker feat can satisfy the parent alternative when its own acquisition was lawful; Frenzied Rage still needs its own lawful opportunity and CON15. The distinct berserker_rage/CF-03 is an operating rage only after Frenzied Rage was otherwise acquired lawfully; it is neither the named berserker parent nor a class-rage credential. No rage need be active merely to prove ownership at acquisition; all use-time rage requirements remain unchanged.
frenzied_rage.scope: class_rage branch only; owned berserker alternative retained
frenzied_rage.facts: An exact operative class feature expressly grants a rage state; an independent source-qualified acquisition/grant history assigns that feature to the actor at the required actual class level/path/selection before this acquisition. The source and actor assignment must match; catalog membership alone is insufficient.

divine_favor.wording: KEEP CHA15 and actual already-established worship of a deity. Require source-linked evidence that the same character's worship relationship to an already-established opaque deity reference qualifies at the acquisition snapshot. Neither a class title, ancestry, background label, description of favor, story label nor a worship:true assertion proves that relationship. Do not add a separate favor award, doctrine, minimum observance period, ritual, fee or new deity choice. An explicitly conditional test-world record can exercise this literal predicate only as CONDITIONAL_ONLY; missing actual-world evidence leaves actual acquisition unavailable. The complete operating procedure is unchanged.
divine_favor.facts: A literal worship relationship from this character to one already-established opaque deity reference, established before and qualifying at the acquisition snapshot. Its evidence and authority must establish this relationship, not merely the existence of the deity or a class/background.

elemental_body.wording: KEEP CON15 and an actual recorded event satisfying exposure to an elemental plane before acquisition. The event must link this character, its world and an already-established opaque plane reference under a bound authority and literal predicate source. Elemental damage, a resistance, a Drakari variant, a class spell or a generic visit does not by itself establish the printed exposure predicate. Do not invent a plane, exposure duration/intensity, causal infusion test or element-to-plane matching requirement. Retain the previously adopted permanent acid/cold/fire/lightning/thunder choice, recorded separately from the exposure evidence. A valid conditional fixture exercises the predicate only as CONDITIONAL_ONLY; it supplies no campaign event. The complete operating procedure is unchanged.
elemental_body.scope: exposure credential and existing permanent type choice
elemental_body.facts: A source-qualified actual prior exposure event, this actor as exposed subject, one already-established opaque elemental-plane reference and the event order; no continuing-presence requirement. Record one permanent choice from acid, cold, fire, lightning, thunder separately; no inferred type-to-plane mapping.

dragon_blood.wording: KEEP (actual Dragonborn lineage OR actual Sorcerer class with draconic bloodline) AND one recorded draconic ancestry damage type from that same qualifying source, with the independently paid opportunity and all other actual gates. The supplied current14 lineages/45 variants and17 class options establish neither literal Dragonborn nor a Sorcerer class. Drakari, Mage, a feat-only Sorcerer curriculum, Draconic literacy, a dragon-like name or an unbound class-level label supplies no alias or lineage grant. Preserve both alternatives and the full feat, but actors lacking the exact admissible external lineage/class-and-bloodline source remain ineligible. A clearly isolated conditional imported-legacy fixture may test either branch, including its source-bound damage type, without adding a selectable lineage/class, authenticating a campaign history or changing any current flag. The complete operating procedure and reviewed language interaction are unchanged.
dragon_blood.scope: both lineage/class alternatives and the linked damage-type condition
dragon_blood.facts: Either a source-qualified actor assignment of literal Dragonborn, or an actual authorized Sorcerer class assignment of at least1 class level plus an actual draconic-bloodline grant. Both branches require exactly one recorded actual damage type explicitly bound to that same qualifying lineage/bloodline source. A free type choice or a different actor/source type is insufficient.
